product.name: Decentralized Wastewater Treatment System (DWWS)
product.description: A system designed to treat wastewater on-site, allowing for its reuse in gardening and farming, suitable for areas without sewerage access.

product.name: Black Water System
product.description: A system for managing and treating black water, which is wastewater containing human waste.

product.name: Grey Water System
product.description: A system for treating grey water, which is wastewater from sinks, showers, and washing machines, for potential reuse.

product.name: Consultations
product.description: Advisory services related to water and sanitation systems, including pre and post-installation support.
